label: Search index name uniqueness constraint
type: since Server 7.6, an index name must be unique within its bucket and scope (previously, presumably, a looser scope - no page states the pre-7.6 rule explicitly).
evidence: For Couchbase Server version 7.6 and later, your index name must be unique inside your selected bucket and scope. You cannot have 2 indexes with the same name inside the same bucket and scope.
relates_to_competency_question: At what scope must a Search index's name be unique - the whole cluster, a bucket, or a bucket-and-scope pair?
